title.rendered: Drew Holcomb and Tift Merritt: Hungry Heart

content.rendered:
There was always a country song deep down in Bruce Springsteen’s “Hungry Heart,” and Drew Holcomb and Tift Merritt found it back in 2017 when they appeared together on an episode of eTown.

Skip past the first minute of rehearsal footage if you must, but don’t miss their gorgeous cover performance that follows–it’s one of my favorite covers of a Springsteen song.

When I first heard Holcomb and Merritt’s performance, it was a revelation—their arrangement of “Hungry Heart” feels so natural, so perfectly suited to the lyrics that I have to wonder whether Bruce ever envisioned it that way himself.

© December 26, 2019

excerpt.rendered: Drew Holcomb and Tift Merritt discover the country song that was always lurking at the core of Bruce Springsteen’s “Hungry Heart.”

jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When Britt Daniel of Spoon and Dan Boeckner of Wolf Parade formed Divine Fits, one of the covers they performed together was Bruce Springsteen's "Hungry Heart." Check it out inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Written for The Ramones and influenced by The Byrds, The Four Seasons, and The Beach Boys, "Hungry Heart" gave Bruce his first Top Ten hit.

jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: At a special tribute radio show on the occasion of Bruce's 70th birthday, Springsteen fans The Head and The Heart closed the show with their lovely cover of "Hungry Heart."
